texts.zh:
一队调查小组在[Root.GetName]上发现了隐藏的工厂。根据建筑构架和磨损程度判断，它源自一个古老文明，这个文明十分擅长建造经得起时间考验的建筑。

我们可以轻松使用这个工厂，增加殖民地的产出。
texts.en:
A group of investigators have found a hidden factory on [Root.GetName]. The building and its state of decay tells of an old civilization, one that excelled at constructing things that stood the test of time.

Our population would easily be able to use the facility to add to the colony's production output.

label.zh: 权重30：工厂开始绑架工人（需≥100名工厂工人）
label.en: Weight 30: the factory starts kidnapping workers (needs 100+ factory workers)

label.zh: 权重35：无事发生，约6个月后收尾
label.en: Weight 35: nothing happens; closing note after about 6 months

texts.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上古怪工厂工作的员工突然消失了！我们可以派遣工人替补，或者以防万一，直接将工厂夷为平地。
texts.en: The crew we assigned to work the odd factory on [Root.GetName] has disappeared! We could send a new workforce to take their place, or we could raze the facility to the ground, making sure that this will not happen again.

label.en: Option a: 50% falls back to nothing

notes.zh: 选项b关闭工厂（移除矿藏）并终结故事；选项a继续。因标志在选项b后未清除，但矿藏已移除，触发条件不再满足。
notes.en: Option b shuts the factory (removes the deposit) and ends the story; option a continues. The kidnap flag stays after b but the deposit is gone, so the trigger fails.

texts.zh:
到那个古怪工厂工作后，第二队工人也失踪了！所幸，其中一个工人留下了记录。记录显示那里有不少的陷阱，这些陷阱专门用来抓捕毫无防备的工人。

陷阱已经移除，现在应该可以正常使用工厂了。但不论如何解释，民众仍对潜在的致命陷阱忧心忡忡。
texts.en:
A second group of individuals has gone missing after working at the odd factory! Fortunately one of the workers was able to leave a recording behind, revealing that there are traps capturing unsuspecting workers.

The traps have been disabled and we should be able to use the factory without further issues. However, the populace are none too happy about the potential death trap, no matter what we say.

label.en: The people will get used to it.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的古怪工厂并未出现任何异常。殖民地将维持预计的产出。
texts.en: No reports of any problems have been issued from the odd factory on [Root.GetName]. It seems like the colony will maintain the projected production estimates.

summary.text:
# 古怪工厂 / An Odd Factor

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/colony_events_2.txt:2360-2584`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3763,3815`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 殖民地2岁（15/958）或3岁（10/739）时的随机事件；非机械/荒野帝国；每个帝国一次（colony_odd_factory）。事件给星球添加“怪异工厂”矿藏（需要玩家安排工人）。
  Random colony event at age 2 (15/958) or 3 (10/739); non-machine, non-wilderness empire; once per empire (colony_odd_factory). The event adds an "Odd Factory" deposit (the player must staff it).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 2015「怪异因素」：随机列表，权重30设绑架标志，权重35设“无事”标志。
  2015 "An Odd Factor": a random list; weight 30 sets the kidnap flag, weight 35 the no-effect flag.
- 绑架线：矿藏有≥100名工厂工人时，平均4个月后 2016（工人失踪1%）。选项b关闭工厂；选项a继续，再50%进入 2017（再次绑架，选项a使人口惊恐、选项b结束）或50%进入“无事”线。
  Kidnap line: with 100+ factory workers, 2016 (1% of workers vanish) fires after a mean of 4 months. Option b shuts the factory; option a continues, then 50% 2017 (second kidnapping; a scares the pops, b ends) or 50% the nothing line.
- 无事线：平均6个月后 2019，故事结束。
  Nothing line: 2019 after a mean of 6 months; the story ends.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 绑架线与无事线互斥。
  The kidnap line and the nothing line are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无。
  None.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发、随机权重、两次绑架的触发标志与均值、选项效果。
  Checked: trigger, random weights, trigger flags and means of both kidnappings, option effects.
- 更正：2016、2017、2019 原为各自孤立的故事，现并入（标志衔接）。
  Correction: 2016, 2017 and 2019 were isolated stories; merged here with flag bridges.
